prompts.lower: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET and strict character reference. Create a TRANSPARENT sprite animation sheet with 4 equally sized cells arranged 2 columns x 2 rows, no labels or lines. Each cell shows ONLY this character's LOWER BODY: belt-down green front skirt/tabard with bottle, upper thighs and both brown boots with leaf on left boot. No torso, arms, head, hair or back cape. Preserve exact original chunky low-resolution pixel art, dark plum outlines, original green/brown colors, proportions, facing three-quarter RIGHT. No extra detail or smooth shading. Same scale and waist anchor in all four cells. Each cutout fits within its cell with 12% margin. Top left: walk contact pose left boot forward right boot back. Top right: passing walk pose both legs closer together, right knee slightly bent. Bottom left: opposite walk contact right boot forward left boot back. Bottom right: jump pose both knees bent and boots tucked under body. Upper green skirt waist stays fixed with identical width and height across all 4 poses. Crisp hand-drawn sprite frames, not rotated or stretched parts. True transparent background. This is a registered lower-body animation layer to attach to the ORIGINAL upper body, so preserve the reference's proportions and pixel size. Include ONLY lower-body pieces, no full character.
prompts.torso: Use case: precise-object-edit. Strict reference/edit target: the attached orange-haired forest girl. Produce one animation sprite sheet for ONLY THE TORSO WITH BOTH COMPLETE ARMS AND HANDS, excluding head, hair, cape, legs, boots, waist pouch and lower skirt. Four cells in a regular 2x2 grid, true transparent background, no labels/grid. Original green tunic with white puff sleeves, brown diagonal leather strap, brown forearm bracers and light peach hands. Keep the ORIGINAL chunky pixel art, plum dark outlines and original pixel density, no smooth shading. Three-quarter facing right. Same torso size, shoulder height, fixed neck position and fixed waist position in ALL four cells. Frame top left: neutral original arms lowered. Frame top right: anticipation, right fist pulled toward chest. Frame bottom left: clear punch attack, right forearm fully extending to the right, left hand close to chest. Frame bottom right: follow through, right arm slightly bent returning down. NO WEAPON. Identical underlying torso between poses, change only arms. Generous empty transparent space on right for extended punch, equal framing in all cells; never auto-fit individual frames. This is a registered animation LAYER, not a complete character. Torso ends at waist just above belt. Preserve costume and proportions faithfully.
prompts.torso_cleanup: Use case background-extraction. Edit target is this four-frame pixel-art torso animation sheet. Change ONLY background: remove ALL background, glow, haze and ghost lettering to TRUE zero-alpha transparency. Keep every hard-edged pixel of the four torso poses exactly unchanged in position, scale, color, outline and orientation. Preserve the exact canvas dimensions and four sprite positions. Hard clean alpha edges around the sprites; no blur, no shadow, no colored halo, no checkerboard, no text. Keep dark plum sprite outlines opaque, remove everything outside the character silhouettes. Output transparent PNG.
prompts.hair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is strict reference. Create a 2x2 pixel-art sprite sheet of ONLY THE LONG ORANGE HAIR AND WHITE FLOWER of this exact character. Remove all skin, eyes, face, body, clothes, cape and limbs, leaving a hollow transparent face opening. This is a front hair overlay including crown, fringe and long left/right locks, not a wig on a head. Match the source's large chunky pixels, dark plum outlines, flame orange palette and asymmetric silhouette exactly. All four frames have same head anchor and same scale. Top left original relaxed hair shape; top right gentle breeze shifts only bottom ends a few pixels left; bottom left gentle breeze shifts only ends right; bottom right locks lift slightly during a jump. Crown and face opening remain identical across frames. 2 columns 2 rows, equal cells, wide transparent separation, generous margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, absolutely no glow or shadows, no backdrop, no labels, no grid lines. Preserve original flower position and original proportions. Do not redesign or add detail.
prompts.cape: Use case precise-object-edit. Isolate ONLY the dark forest-green ragged BACK CAPE visible down the LEFT SIDE of the attached character. Create a 2x2 transparent sprite animation sheet for that cape with 4 drawings. No character, hair, skin, head, legs, belt, bottle or front skirt. It is an asymmetric cape behind the character, anchored at the upper RIGHT shoulder, flowing diagonally down and to the LEFT with leaf-green highlights and jagged leafy lower hem. Reconstruct its hidden central green fabric so it can sit behind torso. Match ORIGINAL low-resolution chunky pixel art, dark plum outline, olive and dark forest green palette exactly. All 4 cells have SAME SCALE and identical shoulder anchor near upper right. Top left resting drape; top right slight wave to left; bottom left slight wave to right; bottom right rising outward during jump. Clear distinct hand-drawn shapes with only modest changes, not stretchy distortions. 2 columns x2 rows, equal cells, transparent margins around every cutout. True transparent background, no glow, no shadows, no text or grid.
prompts.eyes: Use case precise-object-edit. Reference is this character, specifically its eyes. Make a small animation asset sheet: FOUR PAIRS OF EYES ONLY, on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, in 2 columns x 2 rows. No face skin, head, hair or body. Preserve the exact chunky square-pixel style, dark almost black plum eyes, white rectangular gleams, and three-quarter perspective of the reference (left eye slightly larger than right). Top left original open eyes. Top right half-closed sleepy eyes, plum lid and lower white glint. Bottom left closed eyes, two simple dark plum horizontal pixel lines. Bottom right angry eyes with angled upper eyelids. Keep EXACT SAME pupil centers, distance between eyes and scale in all four cells, equal margins. These are eye overlays for the original face, not independent heads or icons. No lashes added, no circles, no smooth antialiasing, no glow, no labels, no text, no grid. Make the four pairs small with ample empty transparent padding, not huge enlarged eyes.
prompts.head: Use case precise-object-edit. Extract and reconstruct only the SKIN HEAD, small pointed ears and short neck of the attached pixel-art character. Remove all hair, flower, eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, clothing and body. Blank face is needed as an underlay for separately animated eyes and hair. Keep same source peach skin colors, subtle cheek blush, tiny nose pixel, square chunky pixel geometry, dark plum outline and three-quarter facing right perspective. Create ONE transparent 2x2 sprite sheet with four near-identical head drawings: top left neutral original face angle; top right chin slightly lowered; bottom left chin slightly raised; bottom right slight forward attack posture. Very small pose differences, no full profile view. Same scale and neck anchor throughout all 4 equal cells. Include forehead reconstructed behind hair, don't add a mouth or new facial features. True clean transparent background, no halo, no shadows, no labels, no grid. The blank head will sit underneath the original hair and separate eyes; preserve source face proportions.
